messages:
maria: FYI saw a batch of slow tenant handoffs yesterday in eu-west. preemptible -> dedicated handoff took ~3-4s and we fell back to the cold routing path; egress credits dropped to 0 in the middle of the handoff.

maria: Logs (repro):
```
2026-03-19T23:11:58Z HANDOFF start tenant=tn-881 mode=preemptible->dedicated alloc_id=a1b2
2026-03-19T23:11:58Z EGRESS_LEDGER delta=-1200 tenant=tn-881 pool=euwest-dedicated credits_before=400 credits_after=-800
2026-03-19T23:11:59Z ROUTER fallback_to_cold tenant=tn-881 reason="egress_quota_exhausted"
2026-03-19T23:12:00Z HANDOFF complete tenant=tn-881 latency_ms=3187
```

maria: The negative credits here look wrong — we should have reclaimed preemptible credits on eviction but ledger shows a straight deduction.

alex: Do we have a matching record in the allocator for the reserved egress tokens? Could be a reservation leak during slot handoff.

ken: +1. Also curious if NAT port reuse / conntrack is delaying resource return. I saw a couple of sockets in TIME_WAIT on the preemptible side last week.

maria: Repro script (quick):
```
# allocate preemptible
curl -X POST $API/alloc -d '{"tenant":"tn-881","size":1,"tier":"preemptible"}'
# force eviction
kubectl exec -n pool -- /bin/sh -c 'kill -9 $(pidof inference-worker)'
# immediately request dedicated
curl -X POST $API/alloc -d '{"tenant":"tn-881","size":1,"tier":"dedicated"}'
```

jamie: infra-bot also fired at the same window: "egress-credit-burn" alert in eu-west. infra-bot: can you paste the alert id?

infra-bot: Alert fired: egress-credit-burn:euwest:2026-03-19T23:12:05Z id=ac-9981 severity=warning

alex: I inspected the allocator code path — handoff does a two-phase commit: 1) reserve target tokens; 2) release source tokens on success. If step 2 races with an eviction cleanup path that already reclaimed source, we might double-deduct. I can add an idempotent reclaim function.

maria: That would explain the negative delta. Also noticed some long GC pauses on the broker which delayed the reclaim RPC by ~300ms. Combined with immediate dedicate request, target saw zero available and routed to cold.

ken: For a quick mitigation, can we make the router tolerate a short credit negative by short-circuiting to a lightweight credit-grant RPC to the ledger before falling back? i.e. attempt fast temporary grant for handoff windows.

alex: I can spike a patch that allows a +temp grant of up to 1000 tokens for 500ms if handoff in-flight. Will send PR to staging. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/infra/egress-temporal-grant (WIP)

ops-oncall: Paged. I'll throttle the egress router fallback and add a temporary rule to prefer old-route until the allocator fix lands. Monitoring alerts enabled for negative-ledger entries.

maria: After enabling throttle at 23:45 we saw the next handoff complete in 220ms and credits stayed >=0.

jamie: Action items:
- alex: make reclaim idempotent and add unit tests for race (ETA: today EOD)
- alex: open canary to staging for temporal grant patch (ETA: 2h)
- ken: look into conntrack/TCP TIME_WAIT patterns and whether sockets are delaying resource churn (ETA: tomorrow)
- ops-oncall: keep monitoring dashboards for negative ledger spikes and handoff latencies (follow up in #oncall-summary)

alex: started the PR: https://git.redwood/pr/infra/egress-reclaim-idempotent (now in review). Will attach logs once CI passes.

maria: Thanks. If anyone hits a tenant with repeated handoffs (esp. multi-shard tenants), please CC me and I'll run the ledger diff tool (scripts/ledger-diff).

ken: Noted. Also we should audit other resource ledgers (nvlink, pci-bw) for similar leakage patterns.

ops-oncall: Keeping an eye. Will update in 30m with the dashboard snapshot.

maria: closing loop — after deploy to staging and a small canary in eu-west, no negative balances seen for 6 canary handoffs. Moving to prod canary at 02:00 UTC.

alex: thanks all, I'll post a follow-up thread with PR links and postmortem if the prod canary shows anything.

infra-bot: Note: scheduled prod canary for egress-temporal-grant at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z by alex
